qwen.baseline: no intervention with identical full context
qwen.score: argmax of next-token logits for all offered option letters

primary_metric: MCQA accuracy over all 7747 records in each arm
coverage_metrics: A1 at least one T or F
label_policy: No invented per-rule labels. No rule accuracy calculation.
error_policy: A1 error is null; no signal. All cases remain in paired Qwen and denominator.
